name: parallel_execution
description: Coordinator for concurrent agent and task execution. Spawns isolated execution contexts for sub-agents, enforces declared concurrency caps per engine, and merges their outputs deterministically. Context isolation per Engineering Law 15 (Session Hygiene).

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: [{ task_id, agent_id or engine_id, demand, depends_on[] }] to execute concurrently.

inputs.name: strategy
inputs.description: Merge strategy: 'race' (first success wins) | 'all' (wait for all) | 'quorum' (majority).

outputs.name: merge_key
outputs.description: Deterministic key combining sorted task_id + status values for reproducibility (Constitution Principle 4).

side_effects: Creates isolated context per task; torn down after completion (Law 10, Law 15)
Emits AIOS-EVENT-000014 task_started and AIOS-EVENT-000015 task_completed

error_codes.message: A task exceeded its declared performance_budget.max_latency_ms.
error_codes.recovery: Cancel the task, record partial output if any, propagate AIOS-EVENT-000016 task_timeout.

error_codes.message: Tasks depend on each other cyclically.
error_codes.recovery: Detect cycle, abort the whole batch, surface the cycle to operator (do not silently retry).

examples: parallel_execute(3 sub-agent tasks, strategy=all) -> results[3] with same merge_key across runs.
